title: Tola and Jair

questions.question: Who arose to save Israel after Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Judges 10:1 (ESV): "After Abimelech there arose to save Israel Tola the son of Puah..."

questions.question: Who arose after Tola?
questions.explanation: Judges 10:3 (ESV): "After him arose Jair the Gileadite..."

questions.question: What unique possession did Jair's 30 sons have?
questions.explanation: Judges 10:4 (ESV): "And he had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys, and they had thirty cities..."

questions.question: Into whose hands did the Lord sell Israel this time (Chapter 10)?
questions.explanation: Judges 10:7 (ESV): "...he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the Ammonites..."

questions.question: What did the people say to the Lord when they cried out?
options: We have sinned, because we have forsaken our God and served the Baals
questions.correctAnswer: We have sinned, because we have forsaken our God and served the Baals
questions.explanation: Judges 10:10 (ESV): "...saying, 'We have sinned against you, because we have forsaken our God and have served the Baals.'"

questions.question: How long did Tola judge Israel?
questions.explanation: Judges 10:2 (ESV): "And he judged Israel twenty-three years..."

questions.question: How long did Jair judge Israel?
How did God initially respond to Israel's cry?
options: Go and cry out to the gods whom you have chosen; let them save you
questions.correctAnswer: Go and cry out to the gods whom you have chosen; let them save you
questions.explanation: Judges 10:14 (ESV): "Go and cry out to the gods whom you have chosen; let them save you in the time of your distress."

questions.question: What did the people do to show their repentance?
options: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the Lord
questions.explanation: Judges 10:16 (ESV): "So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD..."

questions.question: Where were Jair's cities located?
questions.explanation: Judges 10:4 (ESV): "...called Havvoth-jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead."

questions.question: Tola was from which tribe?
questions.explanation: Judges 10:1 (ESV): "...Tola the son of Puah, son of Dodo, a man of Issachar..."

questions.question: Where did Tola live?
options: Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim
questions.correctAnswer: Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim
questions.explanation: Judges 10:1 (ESV): "...and he lived at Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim."

questions.question: The Ammonites crossed the Jordan to fight against which tribes?
options: Judah, Benjamin, and the house of Ephraim
questions.correctAnswer: Judah, Benjamin, and the house of Ephraim
questions.explanation: Judges 10:9 (ESV): "And the Ammonites crossed the Jordan to fight also against Judah and against Benjamin and against the house of Ephraim..."

questions.question: How long were the Israelites oppressed by the Ammonites this time?
questions.explanation: Judges 10:8 (ESV): "...For eighteen years they oppressed all the people of Israel..."

questions.question: What does the text say about God's reaction to their misery (after repentance)?
options: He became impatient over the misery of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: He became impatient over the misery of Israel
questions.explanation: Judges 10:16 (ESV): "...and he became impatient over the misery of Israel."

key_verse_text: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD, and he became impatient over the misery of Israel. (ESV)
